description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Quesnel is a branded chain hotel on St. Laurent Avenue in Quesnel, a significant service hub in BC's Cariboo region situated along Highway 97. Quesnel is a key resupply and overnight stop for cyclists traveling the interior of British Columbia, including those on the Gold Rush Trail corridor. The property is part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts network with loyalty program integration.
